name: N0-AH
description: N0-AH was an SK series astromech droid that had white body with orange, teal and turquoise plating. After the Battle of Endor, a group of Jawas on Tatooine offered N0-AH in exchange for a camtono of silicax oxalate crystals in the possession of Cobb Vanth, however Vanth instead settled for a set of Mandalorian armor, which originally belonged to bounty hunter Boba Fett. The droid was equipped with a restraining bolt, and was stained and worn by Tatooine's environment.
